summary: A Yes vote renews the district's $99 per parcel annual tax for 12 years, raising about $1.8 million annually for academic programs and teacher retention.

tax.text: Yes on Measure J renews an expiring $99 parcel tax for 12 years to keep funding San Lorenzo school programs and retain teachers.
tax.quote: To renew expiring local school funding without increasing current tax rates; support academic excellence and programs in reading, writing, math, arts, science and technology; attract and retain highly qualified teachers and staff; and continue stable, local funding the State cannot take away

schools.text: A Yes vote would maintain locally raised funding for San Lorenzo Unified academic programs and instructor retention.
schools.quote: SLZUSD's last voter-approved parcel tax is set to expire this year, which would cause the loss of $1.8 million annually for academic programs and instructor retention.
